name: When should I change my kitchen layout instead of just replacing cabinets?

mainEntity.name: When should I change my kitchen layout instead of just replacing cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should update your layout if your kitchen suffers from persistent congestion, awkward door swings, insufficient prep surfaces, or isolated work areas. Cosmetic updates like painting cabinets or replacing countertops only improve appearance, not functionality. If your refrigerator door blocks the main walkway when open, or if your prep space is isolated far from the sink, your daily routine will still feel frustrating after a cosmetic refresh. A layout update solves foundational flow issues by rebuilding the floor plan around how you actually use the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Change the layout if your current kitchen has severe bottlenecks, poor workflow, or inadequate counter space that simply replacing cabinet doors or finishes cannot fix.
